sources.title: Code of practice for wireless network development in England
sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.verified_claim: The official code covers siting, design, consultation and applications for wireless infrastructure including mobile masts and cabinets; best-practice guidance is not candidate-specific planning consent.

sources.title: Code of practice for wireless network development in England - full guidance
sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.verified_claim: The guidance brings together planning and consultation expectations for code operators and local authorities and balances network delivery with environmental considerations. It does not prove an installation or permission at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Map Your Mobile
sources.verified_claim: Ofcom's checker reports predicted 4G/5G coverage by postcode and broader performance metrics; building materials, trees and local conditions can affect actual coverage, so no parcel-level service guarantee is inferred.

sources.title: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.verified_claim: The Spring 2026 report is a January 2026 snapshot of fixed and mobile coverage based partly on operator signal-strength predictions and publishes downloadable coverage data. National/local coverage is not exact parcel measurement.

sources.title: Connected Nations and infrastructure reports
sources.verified_claim: Ofcom maintains current annual and interim infrastructure reports and distinguishes existing coverage from planned network deployment; planned expansion is not completed service.

sources.title: Connected Nations 2025
sources.verified_claim: The annual report tracks full-fibre and 5G rollout and provides data downloads and methodology; report geography and modelling limitations remain material for candidate use.

sources.title: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026
sources.verified_claim: The May 2026 OMR sought provider evidence on existing and planned gigabit-capable infrastructure over the next three years. Provider plans are not treated as delivered parcel connectivity.

sources.title: National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026 Request For Information
sources.verified_claim: The RFI describes evidence requested from suppliers for gigabit coverage and future build plans. Market-review evidence is rollout context, not proof of a live connection at any sample parcel.
